description:
Perform a comprehensive H2 sub-heading structure audit for the online bookstore 'books.toscrape.com'. 

STEPS:
1. Open Screaming Frog SEO Spider and crawl 'https://books.toscrape.com/'.
2. Wait for the crawl to complete.
3. Navigate to the 'H2' tab to view H2 heading data.
4. Export the H2 tab data as a CSV file to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'.
5. Also export the standard 'Internal > HTML' tab data as a second CSV to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/' for cross-referencing.
6. Analyze the data and create a text report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/h2_structure_report.txt'. The report MUST contain:
   - Total number of pages crawled.
   - Count of pages missing H2 headings.
   - Any observations about duplicate or long H2s.
   - Specific recommendations for the content team.

SUCCESS CRITERIA: Two CSV files exist in the exports directory (one with H2 data, one with Internal HTML data) containing books.toscrape.com URLs. A text report exists with quantitative findings.
